title: Pointwise endpoint limits for nonlocal operators
summary: We establish two pointwise endpoint limits for nonlocal operators: one based on normalized integrals and a distributional limit based on weighted weak-type norms. As applications, the limits yield pointwise Bourgain--Brezis--Mironescu, Maz'ya--Shaposhnikova, Brezis--Seeger--Van Schaftingen--Yung and Gu--Yung formulas, together with higher-order and mean-oscillation variants. We then investigate endpoint limits for fractional powers generated by semigroups and for approximation processes, and derive sharp strong and weak endpoint estimates for operators in harmonic analysis.
